theme: An early call, then an open day.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. After the 7 o'clock call with Mike's team the day runs wide open — a rare clear stretch, with the girls in Florida this week.

needsAttention.title: ICGN wants to set the Toronto planning call
needsAttention.detail: Claudia at ICGN is scheduling the Plenary 7 stewardship-data planning call and is waiting on your availability — you're moderating that session, so it stalls until you reply.

needsAttention.title: Intro to Sun Life's sustainability lead
needsAttention.detail: Pema connected you with Marissa Glassbrook, who runs sustainability initiatives at Sun Life; the intro has sat since yesterday and a quick reply keeps it warm.

needsAttention.title: December trip — book by Oct 15
needsAttention.detail: The all-kids December break still needs a destination locked; holiday inventory for six is thinnest now and the book-by date is nine days out.

flagged.title: Apple sign-in notice on your iPhone
flagged.detail: Apple flags a new account sign-in on the 17e and asks you to re-sign to keep AppleCare coverage — worth a look to confirm it was you.

flagged.title: Amex October statement is ready
flagged.detail: Your October statement posted with a note about important changes.

flagged.title: NACD Maine Visionaries, Oct 28
flagged.detail: NACD New England asked the group to help spread word of the Oct 28 event; Josh Broder has already pitched in, so it's a share-if-you-can, not a must.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, receipts, a listing alert, and an Evite RSVP.

recipe.title: Roast Monkfish
recipe.why: Autumn turns the kitchen toward the oven — a firm cold-water fish, roasted, suits the season.

acts.line: The day starts before dawn with a two-hour Teams call alongside Mike, Martin and Davit.
Nothing else is on the calendar — the whole stretch after nine is yours to steer.
A quiet night with the girls down in Florida this week.
